high_level_description: The image shows two individuals, Demi Moore and Billy Bob Thornton, posing together at what appears to be a red carpet event. The setting is likely the Los Angeles screening of "Landman" Season 2, as indicated by the backdrop which features the title "LANDMAN" in large white letters against an orange background. The backdrop also includes the Paramount+ logo and the acronym "FYC," which stands for "For Your Consideration." Demi Moore is on the left side of the image, wearing a sleeveless black dress with a deep neckline. She has long dark hair and is smiling warmly.
